title: Small Mercies
html:
The Priest already lends people strength for an hour at a time. He wants to teach a mage how to make it last.

About

Given byPriest
Level11
LengthMedium
KindCombat skill unlocks
Quest points2

What you need

  • Wolf Meat ×6

Steps

  1. Talk to Priest (inside Binxonia - Church (near Binxonia)) to get the quest.
  2. Kill 6 wolves on the road south of Binxonia (6)
  3. Bring the Priest 6 wolf meat (6) - Wolf Meat inside Binxonia - Church
  4. Kill 4 baby imps in the Imp Tree (4)
  5. Return to the Priest inside Binxonia - Church

Some steps in between were not recorded.

Rewards

Reward
Gold300
Character XP12,000
Quest points2
UnlocksRestoration magic, Mend

What Priest says

Priest: That will feed the family whose barn burned. Now for something I can't cook away.

Priest: South of the church there's a cave people call the Imp Tree. Something has gotten into the roots down there.

Priest: Go down to the bottom and clear out four of the little ones.

Priest: The roots are quiet. Good. Quiet is where this starts.

Priest: Healing isn't loud, and it isn't much to look at from outside. You press your hand to a wound, and something in you decides the wound is wrong and undoes a little of it.

Priest: That's all mending is. Practice it kindly. I've seen it turned into a leash more than once, on people who didn't ask to be pulled by it.

Priest: Go on. You'll know when it's time to learn the rest.

Handing it in

"You'll know when it's time to learn the rest."
